exam_scheme.note: The Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test (IMU-CET) is conducted annually by the Indian Maritime University (IMU), a Central University under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Government of India. IMU-CET serves as the national gateway for admission to undergraduate programmes (B.Tech in Marine Engineering, B.Sc. in Nautical Science, B.Tech in Naval Architecture & Ocean Engineering) and postgraduate programmes across IMU's six university campuses (Chennai, Kochi, Kolkata, Mumbai Port, Navi Mumbai, and Visakhapatnam) and affiliated maritime training institutes. The undergraduate technical entrance examination is an online Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 200 multiple-choice questions carrying a total of 200 marks, with a test duration of 180 minutes (3 hours). The paper contains five sections: Physics (50 questions), Mathematics (50 questions), Chemistry (20 questions), English (40 questions), and General Aptitude (40 questions). Marking scheme: 1 mark awarded for each correct answer, negative marking of 0.25 marks deducted for each incorrect answer (-0.25), and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
